effects: The signer pays fromTokenAmount of fromToken through the ApproveProxy, split over the hidden DAG paths; when fromToken is 0xEeee, the router wraps fromTokenAmount of ETH.
The signer sends msg.value in ETH. For an ETH swap nothing checks that it equals fromTokenAmount, and any extra ETH stays in the router.
If the calldata ends in a from-token commission suffix, the signer also pays fromTokenAmount*rate/(1e9-rate), up to about 3.1%, to referrers that are not shown.
The signer receives at least minReturnAmount of toToken, after any to-token commission or positive-slippage trim.
The call reverts after deadLine.

findings.title: dagSwapByOrderId is payable but does not show @.value, and ETH sent is not bound to the shown amount

findings.title: dagSwapByOrderId hides a from-token commission that the signer pays on top of 'Amount to Send'

effects: If the top bit of rawdata is 0, the signer sends `amount` of native currency (msg.value must equal it unless there is a from-token commission) and receives `amount` of the chain's wrapped native token.

findings.evidence: DexRouter.swapWrap: `reversed := and(rawdata, _REVERSE_MASK)` with _REVERSE_MASK = 0x80…00 (top bit only). Descriptor enum swapDirection: "1": "WETH --> ETH".
findings.fix: Remove key "1". Keep "0": "Wrap" and "128": "Unwrap".

findings.title: swapWrap prices the amount as mainnet WETH on all 25 chains, where the router uses each chain's wrapped native token

findings.fix: Remove the token constant. Show the amount with format 'amount' (native) or use per-chain descriptors.

findings.fix: State in the intent or the label that fees up to 3% may apply.

findings.evidence: CommonUtils: `SWAP_AMOUNT = 0x…00ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff` (128 bits). Descriptor: path "rawdata.[-17:]".
findings.fix: Change the path to "rawdata.[-16:]".

findings.title: swapWrap enum labels say ETH/WETH on chains such as BSC, Polygon and Avalanche
findings.evidence: Descriptor enums: "ETH --> WETH", "WETH --> ETH". There are 25 deployments, many of them on non-ETH chains.
